commonNameZh: 保存肠内容物的三叶虫标本
overview: Inventory specimen 8 preserves an alimentary tract packed with identifiable shelly prey, offering a rare specimen-level dietary observation.

ecology.diet: Ostracods, hyoliths and stylophorans preserved in the gut
ecology.habitat: Marine benthos inferred from formation and prey
ecology.guild: Opportunistic benthic feeder inferred from one meal

evidenceSummary: Prey identity is directly fossilized in one individual; feeding rate, selectivity, gut chemistry and genus-wide diet remain bounded inferences.

commonNameZh: 澄江螯肢干群检验标本
overview: Micro-CT reconstructions expose pincer-like short great appendages, overlapping exite flaps and a seven-segmented head used in a stem-chelicerate test.

ecology.diet: Feeding mode unresolved beyond pincer-like appendages

evidenceSummary: Tomography directly documents appendages and segments; chelicera and book-gill homology and upper stem-chelicerate placement are matrix results.

commonNameZh: 莫里逊虫神经解剖样本
overview: Carbonaceous films in two specimens preserve optic nerves, a possible cephalic synganglion and a segmental ventral nerve cord in a contested stem-chelicerate context.

ecology.diet: Unknown for the profiled M. symmetrica; M. plenovenatrix supports micropredation only for that species
ecology.habitat: Marine Burgess Shale setting in the cited samples
ecology.locomotion: Walking legs documented in M. plenovenatrix; performance unknown for the profiled M. symmetrica
ecology.bodySize: Centimetre-scale in the cited fossil samples
ecology.guild: Benthic micropredator for M. plenovenatrix; unresolved for the profiled M. symmetrica

evidenceSummary: Elemental mapping supports nervous-tissue interpretation, but incomplete preservation and conflicting appendicular signal keep ancestral organization and placement contested.
